title: Dot grid reveal
description: One dot lands and holds, then multiplies into a dot-matrix grid that spreads from it; the dots swell and take the picture's colours until they read as a halftone of it, then close up into the picture itself. For an opening, a reveal of a photo or video, or a 'from nothing to something' beat. Give `media` (a bin file id); without one a drawn landscape is used.

media.description: The photo or video the dots resolve into (file id); a video's first frame sets the halftone, then it plays.

scene.description: The drawn picture used when no media is given (its colours follow the seed).

cell.description: Grid spacing, px at 1080: smaller is finer.

dots.description: Halftone dots in the picture's colours, or all in the accent (a one-ink print).

resolve.description: End on the picture itself (false: hold the halftone).
